name: Lenovo Legion USB lighting
description: Per-key keyboard and case lighting (logo, vents, neon) of Lenovo Legion laptops with the ITE USB lighting controller (048D, usage page 0xFF89 / usage 0x07): Legion Y740, Legion 7 / 7S Gen 5 and Gen 6, Legion 7 / 7S Gen 7 to Gen 9 and Legion 7 Gen 10 in Direct mode. Adapted from OpenRGB's LenovoUSBController and LenovoGen7And8USBController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Lighting profiles are never saved, brightness and profile are never changed; on exit the laptop gets its own lighting back. The Legion 5 Gen 10 (048D:C195) is held back: OpenRGB has no Direct mode for it. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/lenovo-legion-usb.md.
